_about: George Bird Grinnell's (1849-1938) collections of Plains Indian tales, told to him and set down in English: Pawnee Hero Stories and Folk-Tales (1889), Blackfoot Lodge Tales (1892), The Punishment of the Stingy (1901) and Blackfeet Indian Stories (1913). Clean Gutenberg text; US public domain. The tellers are named where Grinnell names them. His hunting and boys' books are not taken. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).

grinnell-blackfoot-lodge-tales: Blackfoot Lodge Tales: The Story of a Prairie People (1892)
grinnell-punishment-of-the-stingy: The Punishment of the Stingy, and Other Indian Stories (1901)

_excluded.grinnell-other: When Buffalo Ran (PG 15189), Trails of the Pathfinders (53897), Beyond the Old Frontier (54125), the Jack books and Boone and Crockett volumes: history, fiction and hunting, outside a folk-tale batch
